title: Android draft review and fresh-world Qwen 7B context grounding
scope: review generated locations, NPCs, factions and events before confirming an AI world
create a brand-new world on the local Android emulator
complete three turns with Qwen 7B, including a formal ending and a new Run
verify generated entity names and proactive NPC interaction remain grounded without internal IDs

draft_review.review_surface: Android 草案确认前显示生成素材摘要，并明确模型素材与本机 hybrid 规则的边界；Flutter widget test 覆盖地点、NPC、势力、事件摘要和零写入前审阅。

player_flow.world_creation: passed; created from the Android AI world wizard rather than reusing an existing world

completed_run.ending: passed; formal ending lan-dawn persisted and Run status completed

player_flow.context_fixed_turn: passed; narrative used 艾莉森、墨菲斯托 and 老船长, showed proactive NPC contact, and did not expose the internal relationship ID lan or stale name 兰
player_flow.loading: passed; preparing/connecting/generating/applying operation stages remain visible during Qwen generation

change.problem: The Android AI world draft did not make generated material easy to review, and a 7B narrative could see internal IDs and turn them into stale player-facing names.
change.fix: Added a pre-confirmation material summary for locations, NPCs, factions and events; added narrative context mapping and guardrails so the model receives display names and is told not to emit internal IDs or template names.

score.basis: fresh-world play now has a clearer review surface and the context-grounded replay removes a player-visible stale-name failure while preserving the Python-owned ending and Run lifecycle

residual: The model still provides prose and suggestions; chapters, effects, relationships, routes and endings remain intentionally owned by the Python hybrid rules.
Windows package, macOS visible-window gate, physical Android A-F and long-run/restart acceptance remain release blockers.
The next round should not expand this Goal unless a platform package or player-facing P0/P1 issue can be tested in the available environment.
